settings.headline: See clearly, live fully.
settings.copy: Clearview is a modern eye-care clinic built around one idea: your eyes deserve more than a quick chart and a rushed prescription. We take the time to understand how you actually see — at work, on the road, in the dark — and fit lenses to your life, not just your acuity.

settings.title: Every kind of
settings.intro: From routine exams to dry-eye therapy and specialty contact lenses, Clearview handles the full spectrum of everyday eye care — with the same optometrist across visits.

design.title: Comprehensive eye exams
design.text: A full workup — acuity, refraction, eye-health screening, and digital retinal imaging — so we catch problems early, not after they've cost you vision.

design.title: Contact lens fittings
design.text: From daily disposables to toric and multifocal lenses, we fit and trial lenses until they're comfortable and clear — not just 'good enough'.

build.title: Precision lenses
build.text: Blue-light, progressive, and high-index lenses measured to your exact frame and your exact habits — screen-heavy, driving, or both.

build.title: Frames for every face
build.text: A curated optical with frames from independent makers and familiar brands, adjusted and fitted on-site by our opticians.

launch.title: Dry-eye therapy
launch.text: A dedicated dry-eye program — diagnosis, in-clinic treatments, and a home plan — for the burning, gritty eyes so many people just put up with.

launch.title: Medical eye care
launch.text: Management of glaucoma, diabetes-related eye changes, and other conditions, with co-management alongside your primary care team.

settings.title: What to
settings.intro: A Clearview exam is unhurried and transparent. Here's the path from the front door to your new prescription.

steps.title: Check in & relax
steps.text: A warm welcome, a quick health-history chat, and a seat in our bright, calm waiting room. No long forms, no pressure.

steps.title: The full workup
steps.text: Your optometrist runs a complete exam — acuity, refraction, eye-health screening, and a digital retinal image. You'll see your own retina on the screen.

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: We explain what we found in plain language and ask about your real life — screens, driving, sports — so the prescription fits how you live.

steps.title: Choose your lenses
steps.text: Our opticians help you pick frames and lens options that match your prescription and your budget, with transparent pricing up front.

steps.title: Pick up & follow up
steps.text: Most glasses are ready in a week. We adjust them to fit, and we follow up to make sure they feel right in the real world.

settings.note: Most new patients are in and out in about 45 minutes — and leave knowing more about their eyes than they ever have.

settings.title: The difference is
settings.intro: Anyone can read a chart. We think the job is to understand your eyes — and your life — well enough to fit lenses that disappear into your day.

features.title: Digital retinal imaging
features.text: A high-resolution photo of the back of your eye on every exam — no dilation drops, and a permanent record we compare year to year.

features.title: Lenses for your life
features.text: We ask about your screens, your commute, your hobbies — then fit lenses for how you actually use your eyes, not just your acuity number.

features.title: The same optometrist
features.text: You see the same clinician across visits, so your history, your concerns, and your progress are all in one head — and one record.

features.title: Transparent pricing
features.text: Every exam, lens, and frame is priced clearly up front. No surprise add-ons, no pressure to upgrade, no mystery line items.

features.title: Modern equipment
features.text: Digital imaging, automated refraction, and up-to-date diagnostic tools mean faster, more accurate exams and earlier detection.

features.title: Care for the whole family
features.text: From a child's first exam to senior eye-health monitoring, we see every age — and we make kids feel comfortable, not scared.

settings.title: Clearer eyes,
settings.intro: The best measure of our work is how people feel when they walk out — and how they see the world after.

settings.title: Before you book,
settings.intro: The questions patients ask us most before their first visit.

items.question: How often should I get an eye exam?
items.answer: For most adults, every one to two years. If you have diabetes, a family history of glaucoma, or wear contact lenses, we'll likely recommend yearly exams. Children should have their first exam before starting school.

items.question: Do I need dilation drops?
items.answer: Not usually. We use digital retinal imaging, which photographs the back of your eye without drops — so you can drive yourself home and get back to your day. Drops are only used when a specific condition calls for them.

items.question: Will my insurance cover the exam?
items.answer: Most vision and medical plans cover routine eye exams. We verify your benefits before your visit and give you a clear estimate, so there are no surprises at the front desk.

items.question: How long does it take to get my glasses?
items.answer: Most single-vision and progressive lenses are ready in about a week. We'll call you when they arrive and adjust them to fit perfectly when you pick them up.

items.question: Can you treat dry eyes?
items.answer: Yes — dry eye is one of the most common things we treat. We offer a dedicated program with in-clinic treatments and a home-care plan, and we'll help you find real relief, not just artificial tears.
